title: US Memorial Day & UK Spring Bank Holiday
desc: Traditional markets are closed, leading to a severe liquidity void. The absence of institutional capital creates thin order books, increasing the probability of erratic, retail-driven volatility across digital assets.

title: US CB Consumer Confidence Index
desc: A critical gauge of retail sentiment regarding economic conditions. A sharp drop could signal emerging weakness in consumer spending, potentially forcing a dovish repricing, while a strong print bolsters the 'higher for longer' narrative.

title: RBNZ Interest Rate Decision
desc: The Reserve Bank of New Zealand sets its benchmark rate. While localized, this serves as an early bellwether for global central bank liquidity trends and the broader fight against sticky global inflation.

title: US Q1 Flash GDP & Core PCE Price Index
desc: The most critical data drop of the week. The PCE is the Fed's preferred inflation metric. Any upside surprise in 'Core' PCE will instantly price out rate cut probabilities, surging real yields and applying heavy downward pressure on risk assets.

title: US Initial Jobless Claims
desc: Released alongside the GDP and PCE data, this will test the resilience of the labor market. An unexpected spike in claims could accelerate a 'bad news is good news' bid for fixed-supply assets.

title: Eurozone Flash CPI (Germany & France)
desc: A real-time look at European inflation dynamics. A cooler European CPI locks in the ECB rate cut narrative, widening the policy divergence with the Fed, which could artificially prop up the DXY.

title: BASED Token Supply Unlock
desc: A scheduled release of 50 million tokens entering circulating supply. Watch for immediate spot selling pressure and localized ecosystem volatility as early investors capture weekend liquidity.

title: BitLogic Alpha Weekly Macro Review
desc: Synthesizing the critical PCE inflation data and GDP revisions into the Net Liquidity Model. The institutional footprint left over the week is mapped to establish 'High-Conviction' zones for the June transition.
